items.text: Complete arrangement of oversized transport permits, including all communication with the authorities. You take care of the cargo, we handle the paperwork.

about.title: About us
about.text: Pilot Convoi Slovakia specialises in escorting oversized and heavy transports. We arrange all the necessary permits, and our experienced pilots ensure a safe and smooth passage for your trucks. We put emphasis on precision, professionalism and an individual approach to every customer — a partner hauliers can always count on.
